title: NANO Nuclear to Hold Third Quarter Business Update Webcast on August 12, 2026
body_markdown:
**New York, N.Y., Aug. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- NANO Nuclear Energy Inc. (NASDAQ: NNE) (“NANO Nuclear” or “the Company”)** , a leading advanced nuclear micro modular reactor and technology company focused on developing clean energy solutions, today announced it will host its third quarter fiscal 2026 business update webcast on


**Wednesday, August 12, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. ET.**


The webcast will follow the anticipated filing of the Company’s Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.


Additional details will be available in the Investor Relations section of NANO Nuclear’s website at


[https://ir.nanonuclearenergy.com/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=YccGsn8k3I0W0RkHqabrwUfS0uQSHPK6DqD-PDcbI6Nrh3fU7fwuJhuFkLT8VBomsO450QgliQOS16tGVfYHjIDQjeIOZXb_mMvjAB0GjXtDGIormq42NrkGDFGyxuBE) .


**Event:** NANO Nuclear Energy Inc. Q3 FY 2026 Business Update Webcast


**Date:** Wednesday, August 12, 2026


**Time:** 5:00 p.m. ET


**Live Call:** 1-877-269-7756 (U.S. Toll Free) or 1-201-689-7817 (International)


**Webcast:**[https://ir.nanonuclearenergy.com/news-events/events](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=-C0oAofeM9z9SWkymInGvx3YkRQFfG583zm2LxD3-_cUmvcwqdKlTnc__Ce-V8DyKlG1X3sY4YPj0lAqgJjtTNP6asBEotP8s1a_rDOnGr527FLTUXpA0w4MXtxSz_Cvsg6g0Prdh5axVJ75HWk3w4M4LDcClEZHGCwFMEk0i5M=)


A replay of the webcast will be made available on NANO Nuclear’s website beginning shortly after the call that evening.


[For Full Official Press Release Press Here](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/08/05/3339300/0/en/nano-nuclear-to-hold-third-quarter-business-update-webcast-on-august-12-2026.html)
